subject: Exec approval needed: Reference program incentives + budget guardrails (Q4)
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Exec approval needed: Reference program incentives + budget guardrails (Q4)

Jordan —

We’re ready to finalize incentives for the case study + customer reference program (target: 3–5 design partners). Need your OK today so Sales/CS can use consistent language in outreach.

Proposed incentives (customer chooses one):
1) Conference sponsorship credit
2) Extended Optimize trial
3) Charitable donation

Key ask: approve the incentive menu + budget guardrails (caps, approvals, and how we execute without creating cash-equivalent issues).

Attached:
- Reference_Program_Incentives_OnePager_v3.pdf
- Reference_Incentives_Budget_Guardrails_Q4-2025.xlsx

If approved, we’ll publish the internal guidance + update the intake workflow (Tyler/RevOps) today and start sending asks tomorrow.

Thanks,
Camila

—
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference


From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 9:38 AM
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Reference program incentives + budget guardrails (Q4)

Thanks. Before I approve:

1) What’s the per-customer maximum exposure (cash + non-cash value)?
2) Any risk of this being construed as pay-for-endorsement? (Need Legal’s view.)
3) How will we ensure we don’t end up with one customer taking 10+ reference calls?

If you can answer those + confirm tracking, I’m comfortable moving quickly.

Jordan


From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 10:07 AM
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Reference program incentives + budget guardrails (Q4)

Jumping in with Finance view + numbers.

1) Per-customer max exposure (cap):
- Cap at $12,000 equivalent value per customer (hard cap).
- Program cap: $45,000 for Q4 (assumes 3–4 customers; we can extend with separate approval).

2) Structure (to avoid “cash” concerns):
A) Conference sponsorship credit
- Paid directly to the conference/event sponsor against a sponsorship line item.
- Customer can be listed as “supported by Redwood” (or not listed if they prefer), but we do NOT pay the customer.
- Proposed cap: up to $7,500 per customer.

B) Optimize trial extension
- Extend Optimize add-on trial by up to 6 months (or provide equivalent credits against Optimize usage), contingent on existing contract terms.
- Proposed cap: up to $12,000 in incremental waived fees, and only for customers already in Dedicated/Private evaluation or contract.

C) Charitable donation
- Donation paid by Redwood to a 501(c)(3) (or local equivalent outside US), with receipt.
- Customer chooses from a pre-approved list or nominates (subject to screening).
- Proposed cap: up to $2,500 per customer.

3) Guardrails / approvals
- Must have executed consent/permission language (Michael’s template) before any incentive is issued.
- Must be tied to specific deliverables: (a) 1 reference call + (b) review of a public case study draft OR written approval for logo/quote usage. (i.e., not a “thanks for talking to us” gift.)
- Any exception >$12k/customer OR >$45k total requires Jordan approval.

CS load control:
- Rachel/Miguel are drafting a “cooldown” policy (e.g., max 2 calls/month/customer) and ability to pause at any time.

Tyler will track incentives + fulfillment in the same intake process (HubSpot + Drive log). Not perfect, but auditable.

Rishi

—
Rishi Malhotra
FP&A, Redwood Inference


From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 10:29 AM
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Reference program incentives + budget guardrails (Q4)

Legal view:

- This is workable if we treat it as a customer marketing program with clear deliverables and written permission.
- Avoid language that implies payment for a “positive” statement. We should use: “in recognition of time spent participating in the reference program” and keep the review/approval window explicit.
- We should include (in the consent form / email) that customer feedback/quotes are subject to customer review and approval, and that they can decline any wording.
- For the charitable donation option, we should document that the customer does not receive anything of value personally.

I’m OK with the menu as proposed provided we:
1) Require signed consent before issuing incentive
2) Route any non-standard terms to Legal

Michael

—
Michael Grant
Legal, Redwood Inference


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Reference program incentives + budget guardrails (Q4)

+1 from Sales leadership.

AEs have been asking for a consistent incentive policy because we’re getting different expectations per account (esp. enterprise security/procurement heavy ones). The structure Rishi outlined is clean.

Request: can we explicitly state “no gift cards / no direct cash payments” in the internal playbook so we don’t have one-off requests?

Stephanie

—
Stephanie Nguyen
VP Sales, Redwood Inference


From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 2:41 PM
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Reference program incentives + budget guardrails (Q4)

Approved with the following guardrails (effective immediately):

1) Caps
- Per customer cap: $12,000 equivalent value
- Program cap (Q4): $45,000 total
- Anything above either cap needs my written approval

2) Allowed incentives (customer chooses ONE)
- Conference sponsorship credit: up to $7,500, paid directly to the event sponsor (not to customer)
- Optimize trial extension/credits: up to $12,000, only for Dedicated/Private eval or contract customers
- Charitable donation: up to $2,500 to a vetted 501(c)(3) (or local equivalent) with receipt

3) Compliance / documentation
- No gift cards. No cash payments. No personal gifts.
- Must have executed consent (logo/quote/reference participation) BEFORE issuing anything.
- Marketing must keep an auditable log: customer, incentive type/value, deliverables, approval date, fulfillment date.

4) Customer load
- Include CS “cooldown” policy in the playbook (max calls/month + opt-out) and enforce it.

Tyler: please make sure the intake process captures incentive selection + approvals so we can report against the cap.

Camila: OK to roll this into the outreach templates.

Jordan

—
Jordan Blake
Finance, Redwood Inference
